sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the Coordinated Construction Act for Lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Requires the filling of elective positions be done publicly and transparently
sponsored.sum: Requires the filling of elective positions be done publicly and transparently in open meetings after giving notice to the public; prohibits the use of executive sessions to fill elective positions.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale, issuance and refund of bonds and notes of New York city
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale of bonds and notes of the city of New York, the issuance of bonds or notes with variable rates of interest, interest rate exchange agreements of the city of New York, the refunding of bonds, and the down payment for projects financed by bonds; extends the New York state financial emergency act for the city of New York; makes further amendments relating to the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers.

sponsored.t: Requires cities that fluoridate public water supplies to comply with certain provisions of law and publish a notice prior to discontinuing such fluoridation
sponsored.sum: Requires cities that fluoridate public water supplies to comply with certain provisions of law relating to fluoridation, and to publish a notice in local newspapers and on the city's website and social media pages at least ninety days prior to discontinuing such fluoridation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Bonnie E. Sullivan, the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan, to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed.

sponsored.t: Relates to designated or rescheduled drugs
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a drug is designated or rescheduled by the federal government, it shall be deemed scheduled under NYS law automatically, without further action by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Alexander D. Rusin to receive retroactive membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Alexander D. Rusin to receive retroactive membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "utility fair acquisition act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "utility fair acquisition act", providing that in any acquisition by a municipal corporation or a public benefit corporation created pursuant to article 5 of the public authorities law of infrastructure operated by a public utility company or private energy provider, the appraised value shall be reduced by the value of infrastructure that was financed through customer user fees, ratepayer surcharges, or other non-investor-funded mechanisms as determined by the public service commission.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Requires state university councils to include the institution's faculty and professional staff
sponsored.sum: Requires state university councils to include the institution's faculty and professional staff.

sponsored.t: Provides that income taxes shall be adjusted to account for a cost of living adjustment
sponsored.sum: Provides that income taxes shall be adjusted to account for a cost of living adjustment for certain tax years.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Erie to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Erie to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Nicholas Cervoni, Thomas Makin, and Sarah Murphy, deputy sheriffs employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting peace officer status to park rangers of Erie county
sponsored.sum: Grants certain park rangers and building security of Erie county peace officer status to issue appearance tickets, simplified traffic informations, simplified parks informations and simplified environmental conservation informations; provides that such shall not be deemed to authorize such officer to carry, possess, repair or dispose of a firearm unless the appropriate license has been issued therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes the upstate cities preparedness and resiliency fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the upstate cities preparedness and resiliency fund which shall distribute grants to upstate cities for projects which demonstrate measurable improvements in preparedness, resilience or emergency coordination.

sponsored.t: Establishes the psilocybin assisted therapy pilot program for veterans and first responders and a psilocybin assisted therapy pilot program fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the psilocybin assisted therapy pilot program; provides such program will be offered to veterans and first responders from New York state; establishes a psilocybin assisted therapy pilot program fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing mental health coordinators for New York state law enforcement
sponsored.sum: Establishes four mental health coordinators to provide mental health support and education for members of law enforcement; establishes that coordinators shall provide training, assistance, reporting and set standards for continuing mental health education.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to study on the long-term safety of tattoo ink and issue a report making recommendations for tattoo ink labeling
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to study the long-term safety of tattoo ink and issue a report making recommendations for tattoo ink labeling.

sponsored.t: Relates to railroad rolling stock
sponsored.sum: Exempts railroad rolling stock from sales and compensating use taxes; defines "railroad rolling stock" as a device, which is used exclusively upon stationary rails or tracks to transport goods, commodities, or equipment, including, but not limited to, flat cars, box cars, gondolas, hopper cars, or other freight railroad cars.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid eligibility for striking workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to automatic Medicaid eligibility for striking workers.

sponsored.t: Eliminates certain publication requirements for limited liability companies and limited liability partnerships; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the requirement that limited liability companies publish their articles of organization and that certain partnerships publish their registrations; establishes the department of state modernization fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the caseloads of preventative services caseworkers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the caseloads of preventative services caseworkers.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Municipal Oversight Of Natural Systems By Allowing Non-Toxic Options Act
sponsored.sum: Allows municipalities to regulate pesticides such that they do not conflict with any laws, rules or regulations related thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Justice for Rachael Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Justice for Rachael Act; creates dangerousness hearings.

sponsored.t: Requires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses
sponsored.sum: Requires a school bus attendant or school bus monitor on all school buses transporting students in kindergarten through sixth grade to or from school or to or from any school related activity.

sponsored.t: Permits electronic arraignment in counties not wholly included within a city; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permits electronic arraignment in counties not wholly included within a city.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Native American and Other Historically Marginalized Groups Discrimination and Injustice Commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Native American and Other Historically Marginalized Groups Discrimination and Injustice Commission which shall complete a study and submit a report regarding discrimination and injustices historically and currently faced by indigenous people and other historically marginalized groups living within the state.

sponsored.t: Requires on-bill financing be an option for certain energy efficiency services and requires the disclosure of on-bill financing prior to the sale of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires on-bill financing be an option for certain energy efficiency services; requires the disclosure of on-bill financing prior to the sale of real property.

sponsored.t: Enacts the robot tax act; imposes a tax on certain businesses when people are displaced from their employment due to certain technologies
sponsored.sum: Imposes a tax on certain businesses when people are displaced from their employment due to certain technologies based on the sum of any taxes or fees imposed by the state or any political subdivision thereof computed based on a displaced employee's wage.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale and installation of certain playground equipment and ground covering which contains recycled tires
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale and installation of certain playground equipment and ground covering which contains recycled tires or any equipment which was made in part or in whole using recycled tires.

sponsored.t: Requires district attorney ethics guidelines to be based exclusively on guidelines set by the New York state bar association
sponsored.sum: Requires district attorney ethics guidelines to be based exclusively on guidelines set by the New York state bar association.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical use of psilocybin; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Relates to medical use of psilocybin; establishes a psilocybin assisted therapy grant program; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York Ireland trade commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York Ireland trade commission.

sponsored.t: Requires a landlord to pay a fee to a tenant if they evict such tenant without cause
sponsored.sum: Requires a landlord to pay a fee to a tenant equivalent to one month's rent if they evict such tenant without cause.

sponsored.t: Declares Pulaski Day a school holiday
sponsored.sum: Declares the last Friday in October, known as Pulaski Day, a school holiday.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing party lines from ballots for all elections that are not presidential or gubernatorial
sponsored.sum: Removes party lines from ballots and has candidates' names appearing only once on a ballot for an office for all elections that are not presidential or gubernatorial.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the Great Lakes and state waters bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Creates a Great Lakes and state waters bill of rights that declares the right of the Great Lakes and state waters to exist, flourish and naturally evolve.

sponsored.t: Establishes a home repair project revolving loan program and revolving loan fund; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a home repair project revolving loan program and revolving loan fund for emergent or essential home repair projects for low and middle-income households.

sponsored.t: Authorizes James Unger to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes James Unger, a town of West Seneca police officer, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the residence of the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna to reside anywhere in Erie county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide construction services to Erie County
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide Erie County with construction, reconstruction, development, improvement, equipping, and expansion services of infrastructure, public areas, and/or a facility or facilities and necessary ancillary and related facilities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the practice of ikizukuri where seafood is prepared as sashimi while the fish is still alive
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the practice of ikizukuri where seafood is prepared as sashimi while the fish is still alive.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale, issuance and refund of bonds and notes of New York city
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale of bonds and notes of the city of New York, the issuance of bonds or notes with variable rates of interest, interest rate exchange agreements of the city of New York, the refunding of bonds, and the down payment for projects financed by bonds; extends the New York state financial emergency act for the city of New York; makes further amendments relating to the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of state police develop a critical incident policy for members of the state police
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of state police to develop, maintain and disseminate to all members of the division of state police a critical incident leave policy requiring critical incident paid leave for any members directly involved in a critical incident; prohibits such superintendent from taking any punitive administrative action against any member of the division of state police granted critical incident leave solely on the basis of the provision of such leave.
